description: 2 tactical challenges for Black against the Blackmar-Diemer Gambit. Decline with 4...e3! or take and develop with tempo.

drills.briefExplanation: 2...dxe4 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.f3 e3! — return the pawn to wreck White's structure.
drills.description: Black to play. White offers the BDG with 2.e4 — take and prepare the e3 counter.
drills.explanation: The Lemberger counter to the BDG: after 2...dxe4 3.Nc3 Nf6, White's 4.f3 is met by 4...e3! — Black returns the pawn to shatter White's kingside structure. White can't take (5.Bxe3?? Ng4 wins), and the e3 wedge cramps White's whole game. The gambiteer becomes the gambited.
drills.name: The e3 Wedge

drills.briefExplanation: 4...exf3 5.Nxf3 Bg4 6.Qd2 Nc6 — take, pin, and develop with tempo on the queen.
drills.description: Black to play. White sacrificed 4.f3 — take and pin the knight at once.
drills.explanation: The Teichmann defense: accept with 4...exf3, and after 5.Nxf3 develop with tempo via 5...Bg4!, pinning the knight. After 6.Qd2 Nc6 Black is a pawn up with easy development — White's 'attack' has no target, and Black's extra pawn will tell in the endgame. Take the material, then develop faster than the attack.
drills.name: Take and Pin

name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit — Black Tactics
